title: worst-group-conformal: code and records for worst-group conformal coverage under spurious correlation
description:
Code and released records for a study of worst-group conformal coverage under spurious correlation, comparing group-conditional calibration against group-robust training. Covers two benchmarks (Waterbirds, CelebA), four backbones, five last-layer training methods, three conformity scores, three calibration policies and a correlation-strength sweep, for about 116,000 conformal evaluations.

The repository ships the records behind every table and figure, so the tables, figures and intervals reported in the accompanying manuscript can be regenerated in minutes without a GPU.
